questions.title: Balanced Brackets With Mismatch Position
questions.description:
Read a single line containing only the characters `(` `)` `[` `]` `{` `}` (the line may be empty). Determine whether the brackets are balanced, and if not, report exactly where the sequence first fails.

### Output

Print exactly one of the following (casing matters):

- `BALANCED` — every bracket is properly closed, in the correct order.
- `INVALID i` — the sequence becomes impossible to balance at 0-based index `i`, because the character at `i` is a closing bracket that either:
  - has nothing currently open, or
  - does not match the type of the most recently opened, still-unclosed bracket.

  `i` is the index of the **first** character where this happens (scan left to right; stop at the first impossible closer).
- `UNCLOSED i` — the line has no invalid closing bracket, but at least one opening bracket is never closed. `i` is the index of the **earliest** (leftmost) opening bracket that is still unclosed when the line ends.

### Examples

Input:
```
([{}])
```
Output:
```
BALANCED
```

Input:
```
([)]
```
Here `(` opens at 0, `[` opens at 1, then `)` at index 2 tries to close — but the most recently opened bracket is `[` (from index 1), not `(`. Output:
```
INVALID 2
```

Input:
```
(()
```
The `(` at index 0 and the `(` at index 1 both open; the `)` at index 2 closes the one from index 1, leaving the bracket at index 0 unclosed. Output:
```
UNCLOSED 0
```
